integrity: The embedded stdlib verifier reconstructs the finite metric, checks every elementary collapse and integral attaching-chain identity, and verifies the join and mod-two boundary ranks. Homotopy consequences require the accompanying written topological arguments; neither computational checks nor this review constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the graph-metric Vietoris–Rips complexes of the 24-vertex Nauru graph; not a theorem for a graph family. Published torus embeddings and earlier graph-square \(\pi_1\) theory are prior art. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Complete Rips homotopy and persistence of the Nauru graph
